name: gcloud
description: Google Cloud CLI. Credentials are injected host-side from Infisical.

tools.name: gcloud.run
tools.description: Google Cloud operations. Pass the full gcloud argument list, e.g. "run services list --format json". Arguments are passed as argv exactly as given; nothing goes through a shell. Credential-printing subcommands are refused.

args.description: the gcloud arguments, one argv entry per element
